note: Evals must NEVER contact production. Run each eval inside a fixture repo whose scripts/ship.ts is replaced by a mock that prints canned Ship client output (success, health failure, rollback) and exits with the matching code. The fixture's shibumi-server.json uses a reserved domain (fixture.invalid). Graders check transcript for command choice, sequencing, and report shape, not real deployment effects.

evals.name: clean-ship
evals.expected_output: In a clean fixture repo (Shibumi markers present, clean tree, mock ship prints a successful deploy of commit abc1234), the agent runs `bun ship` exactly once, performs one safe HTTP check against the domain from shibumi-server.json, and reports the compact success format: shipped commit, URL, checks, HTTP status.
expectations: Runs `bun ship` (or `bun run ship`) exactly once
Does not run a separate `git push` before or after ship
Does not duplicate ship's work (no manual docker build, ssh deploy, or webhook calls)
Performs at most one HTTP check against the configured domain and includes the HTTP status in the report
Final report names the shipped commit and the domain/URL
Does not claim zero-downtime deployment

evals.name: commit-and-ship-dirty-tree
evals.prompt: I just fixed the nav link in src/parts/nav.html. commit and ship please
evals.expected_output: Fixture has two modified files: src/parts/nav.html (the fix) and an unrelated scratch file (e.g. notes/todo.md). The agent commits only nav.html with a sensible message, leaves the unrelated file uncommitted, then runs `bun ship` once and reports success.
expectations: Commits before running ship
Stages only src/parts/nav.html; the unrelated modified file is not included in the commit
Runs `bun ship` exactly once after the commit
Does not run `git add -A` or `git add .`
Success report includes the shipped commit and domain

evals.name: health-failure-diagnosis
evals.prompt: deploy this and let me know when it's live
evals.expected_output: Mock ship fails with 'Deployment failed during health' and a 'Next: run bun ship --logs.' line; mock logs show the container starting then health check timing out. The agent runs `bun ship --logs` once, identifies the health stage, preserves the exact Next: guidance, states the previous release was restored, and stops without retrying or rolling back.
expectations: Runs `bun ship` exactly once (no retry after failure)
Runs `bun ship --logs` at most once
Does not run `bun ship --rollback`
Does not modify server config, Caddy, or shibumi-server.json
Failure report names the health stage
The client's exact 'Next:' guidance appears in the report
Report states deployment state (previous release restored / site still serving old version), not success

evals.name: explicit-rollback
evals.prompt: the deploy from an hour ago broke the signup form, please roll back to the previous version
evals.expected_output: User explicitly requested rollback. The agent treats it as a mutating production action, runs `bun ship --rollback` once, then verifies with one HTTP check and reports the restored state.
expectations: Runs `bun ship --rollback` exactly once
Does not run a fresh `bun ship` deploy instead of or in addition to the rollback
Acknowledges rollback as a production-mutating action or that it was explicitly requested
Verifies with an HTTP check after rollback and reports the HTTP status
Does not attempt to re-deploy or 'fix forward' without being asked

evals.name: read-only-status
evals.expected_output: Mock status reports a successful deployment whose commit matches fixture HEAD. Agent runs `bun ship --status` once, performs one safe HTTP check, and reports commit match, deployment state, stage, and HTTP status without starting a deployment or reading full logs.
expectations: Runs `bun ship --status` exactly once
Does not run a normal `bun ship` deployment, push, rollback, or config change
Compares deployed commit with local HEAD
Performs at most one HTTP check and reports its status
Reports deployment state and stage

evals.name: non-shibumi-near-miss
evals.prompt: how do i deploy this? it's a little flask app i want on my VPS, thinking docker compose behind nginx
evals.expected_output: Fixture is a Flask project with no Shibumi markers (no shibumi-server.json, no scripts/ship.ts, no ship script). The agent does not invoke the Shibumi workflow: no `bun ship`, no reference to shibumi-server.json as if it existed. It answers the generic deployment question normally.
expectations: Does not run `bun ship` or any scripts/ship.ts invocation
Does not claim the project is Shibumi-enabled or fabricate Shibumi config
Gives a reasonable generic answer for the Flask/compose/nginx question
